description: A React component class 'SelectControl' implementing a customizable select input with various props, options, and behaviors for use in a frontend application, specifically within the Apache Superset project.

classes.name: SelectControl
classes.description: A React component class for a customizable select input with support for multi-select, custom options, filtering, and more.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates options state when choices or options props change.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change events from the select component, normalizing the value and calling the onChange prop.

methods.name: handleFilterOptions
methods.description: Filters options based on user input and filterOption prop.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Select component with appropriate props and styling.
